title: Remove Duplicates from Sorted Array - Solution
approach: Scan the array and write unique values to the write index.
intuition: Given an integer array sorted in non-decreasing order, remove the duplicates in-place such that each unique element appears only once. Return the number of unique elements.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
optimized_approach: Scan the array and write unique values to the write index.
common_mistakes: Use two pointers: one write pointer and one read pointer.
